stem: The details about the size of the creek in paragraph 1 are significant to the story’s plot because —

options.label: F
options.text: the creek is too narrow to offer the narrator any protection from the cougar

options.label: G
options.text: the narrator knows exactly where to catch the most fish in the creek

options.label: H
options.text: the creek is so wide and deep that the narrator’s escape route is cut off

options.label: J
options.text: the narrator is so busy studying the creek that he does not notice the cougar right away
